reports.notes: The accepted Business & governance answer (CP-1A, which cannot be replaced) says the split of claims and unapproved change orders is not stated although the third-quarter report prints it (claims 319,986 thousand, unapproved change orders 367,930 thousand), and it reports one customer at 10.8% although the report names a second at 13.3% (24.1% together); CP-2 states both corrections in its text and gaps.

The accepted Business & governance handoff (CP-1A) calls the 4.50x first lien maintenance covenant inactive while the revolver is undrawn, but the 2025 10-K (page 167) says the Term Loan A carries it every quarter; CP-2 states this correction, and CP-1A cannot be edited.

CP-0 and CP-1 were already accepted at attempt 1 when I launched, so I counted one attempt each from the retained request files; the one defect I could not fix is that the CP-1A map tables have cells longer than the 60-character limit in its instructions, which the launcher accepted and which cannot be replaced.

The source set lacks the executed credit agreement and indenture and the 2026 proxy statement, so covenant headroom, the ranking and security of the senior notes and board independence stay unestablished (logged as gaps), and two source conflicts (the Hunt-related lease expiry date and the 2025 repurchase quantum) are unresolvable from the files; CP-0 and CP-1 were already accepted when I started, each with one submission on record.
